system.description: A daemon turned goddess of the Dark Eldarin after giving them a refuge in the Warp from Slaanesh; shunned by order and Chaos alike, she stands alone.
system.summary: A daemon turned goddess of the Dark Eldarin after giving them a refuge in the Warp from Slaanesh; shunned by order and Chaos alike, she stands alone.
commandments: She favors women among her greatest followers; few men willingly serve her.
Sacrifice is required, both your own and that of others.
Only outcomes count, never the means.
directives: Nurture a deep hunger to take whatever you desire.
The deadliest blow comes from a supposed ally; embrace that power.
Know your goal and what you would give up for it.
Pain is understood by all; be ready to inflict it and to heed it.
She ignores sins kept hidden; what matters is keeping the secret.

cults.name: Rabid Feminists
cults.summary: Secretive female-supremacist cults, not only Dark Eldarin, that want women ruling everything and men subjugated.

cults.name: Black Widows
cults.summary: Lone infiltrators and assassins who marry rich or powerful targets and kill them, repeating across worlds.
